m.s: Cook {prawns} in a saucepan of simmering salted water for 2 minutes until pink. Drain, cool under cold water and halve lengthways.
Cook {vermicelli} in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes (check the packet), rinse under cold water and drain really well.
Cut {carrot} and {cucumber} into thin matchsticks and shred {cos}. Pick the leaves from {mint} and {coriander}.
Stir together {fishsauce}, the juice of {lime}, {brownsugar}, chopped {chilli} and 2 tbsp water per serve. Top with crushed {peanuts}.

Dip one sheet of {ricepaper} in warm water for a few seconds until just soft. Lay prawns cut side down in the middle, then herbs, noodles and veg. Fold in the sides and roll up tight. Repeat, about 4 rolls per person.
Serve straight away with the dipping sauce.

l: Wrap each roll in a damp paper towel so they don't dry out, with the sauce in a separate container. Best eaten within a day.
g: Naturally gluten free with rice paper and rice noodles. Check the fish sauce.
